In this method the loop calls tabela0.insere(...) repeatedly (multiple Act operations) to drive the table to capacity, so the test contains many Act invocations rather than a single act under test. VERDICT: non-compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Tests should not depend on other tests or shared mutable state. RATIONALE: Independence enables arbitrary execution order. EVALUATION CRITERIA: Use local variables and no shared state if no @Before/@After present. DECISION RULES: Tests that only use local variables are compliant. The method constructs a local Tabela (tabela0) and uses only local variables; there are no shared mutable fields or missing setup/teardown dependencies. VERDICT: compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Coverage of Normal and Exceptional Flows
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Provide tests for both happy path and error scenarios. RATIONALE: Ensures robustness across normal and exceptional flows. EVALUATION CRITERIA: For each method under test have at least two tests: one happy path and one error case. DECISION RULES: If the class only has tests for success or only for exceptions, mark non-compliant. This class contains only this single test which focuses on the capacity/exception scenario and does not include a separate happy-path test verifying normal insert behavior (e.g., single insert success). VERDICT: non-compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Tests should validate boundary conditions. RATIONALE: Most errors occur at boundaries. EVALUATION CRITERIA: Look for explicit testing of min/max or edge conditions. DECISION RULES: Tests that exercise full/capacity conditions qualify as boundary checks. The test explicitly drives the table until insertion fails due to capacity and asserts the exception and that at least one insert succeeded, which exercises the capacity boundary. VERDICT: compliant.
